text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin didn't show up today 
either.

"From what I've heard, she hasn't shown 
her face at the academy for a while."

It's concerning, but... whether to keep 
running or not is a choice only she can 
make.
That's why—
choice_data_list: (I'll be waiting right here for you.)
(I'll be waiting for you right here.)

text_block_list.text: —Believing in her, always.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(What am I... supposed to do from here on 
out?)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Taishin-chan~. You have a 
visitor, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ticket... What's with you all of a sudden—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Come with me!! Right now!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? A basketball game?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Exaaactly!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The women's basketball player I've been 
following lately is finally in the 
starting lineup for today's game!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, I know you love sports and all, but 
why did you have to drag me into this...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Watching sports always gets me pumped 
up! Like, whoaaa, it really gets my blood 
boiling!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So, that's why... um. You too, Taishin—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Minister, toooooo...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... got it, got it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Fine, I'll watch, alright?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin...!! Heheh, alright, I'll turn on 
the TV then!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, that red-haired girl... if I 
remember right—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—It's good! A buzzer beater!! With her 
eleventh 3-pointer of the match, she seals 
the victory for her team!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH!! Amazing, amazing, amazing, 
SOOOOO AWESOOOOME!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, Taishin!? Isn't she 
amazing!? That red-haired girl!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to be in a slump until around 
last year, but then out of nowhere this 
spring, she grew by leaps and bounds~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Around springtime, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Nobody expects anything from you! Nobody 
thinks you can win!

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it just make you want to give up? 
...Normally, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The post-race interview!! Hey hey, 
looks like she's the one answering!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
“—That was a truly magnificent 
performance!!”

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much!! I'm so glad I could 
show the results of our training!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"'We heard you struggled through a long 
slump, was there a particular turning 
point for you?'"

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
""...As you can see, despite being a 
basketball player, I just wasn't blessed 
with height.""

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
"And with everyone leaving me in the 
dust... I was feeling pretty rotten around 
spring this year."

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
"I used to think that nobody expected 
anything from me anyway, so I might as 
well just quit, but—"

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
"I was given the 'courage to never give 
up.' From someone who's a little contrary, 
but stronger than anyone else, and who 
absolutely never gives up..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (That guy...)

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
“Even though our sports are different, 
that person is the athlete I admire most.”

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why I'm gonna show them too! 
Even if it's awkward, pathetic, or 
warped!"

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
"I want to show everyone, 'Look at me, 
this is who I am!'—and carry myself with 
pride!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAHHH!! I'm zo touched...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"You're doing great for someone so small," 
is that it? That kinda feels like you're 
making fun of me too—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's not true!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I won't give in to adversity!! No matter 
how tough it gets, I'll never give up!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"That resolve of 'I'm definitely gonna do 
this' is so cool! It really inspires me 
and gets me fired up!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"At least... to me, you've always been 
that way, Taishin!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Being small isn't what makes us rivals!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because it's you, that makes you my 
rival!!

"I should go home now. No, just a little 
longer..." How many times had that debate 
played out in my head?

And as the sun began to sink below the 
horizon, —she appeared.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Have you been here the whole time?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah.
...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Were you waiting for me every day?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Why do you believe in me so much?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's been like that ever since you scouted 
me. ...Even though I don't believe in 
myself one bit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know anymore. What am I 
supposed to—"
choice_data_list: Do you want to give up already?
Do you want to give up already?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list:
Choosing not to run is a perfectly valid 
choice in its own right.

Choosing not to run is a perfectly valid 
choice in its own right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No...! I don't want to give up!! How 
could I ever give up in a place like 
this?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But I just don't get it!! I can't take 
pride in who I am! All I see is something 
twisted and pathetic!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Telling me this form is fine, that I 
should keep running like this... There's 
no way I can believe that...!"
choice_data_list:
Then I'll believe enough for the both of 
us!!

Then I'll believe in you enough for the 
both of us!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Throw all your worries at me!
Throw all your worries at me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: A... all of them...?
choice_data_list:
I'll keep telling you 'it's okay' until 
you believe it!

I'll keep saying 'It's okay' until you 
believe it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No... No, no. Why are you stating that 
like it's a fact, anyway...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey... I still haven't changed at all 
since coming here, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Carrying it 'for my sake' or whatever... 
If you shoulder all that, who knows when 
you'll ever be freed from it...
choice_data_list: Take as long as it takes!
Take as much time as you need!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nggghhh, like for my whole life, idiot?!
choice_data_list: For the rest of my life!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ――Haha, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Even for a lifetime" is taking it too 
far, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Seriously... My Trainer's such an idiot.
"I'll try running a little more."

With Narita Taishin having said that, we 
decided to discuss our next target race 
together.

Thinking about how to help Narita Taishin 
look forward again, there was one race I 
wanted to suggest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...The 'Nikkei Sho'?
choice_data_list:
It's held at Nakayama Racecourse, just 
like the Satsuki Sho.

It's held at Nakayama Racecourse, just 
like the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, where the world finally 
came to recognize Narita Taishin's true 
strength.

Nakayama had been a major turning point—so 
why not try running there once more? When 
I proposed this—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll give it a try.
choice_data_list: Are you sure?
Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll give it one more shot... with you.
